names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 martie, «Sfântul Cuvios Alexie de la Goloseev».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Αλέξιος εκ Ρωσίας», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 11 марта ст. ст., «Алексий Голосеевский, Киевский, прп.», with the rank abbreviation left off and «Киевский» with it: the Goloseevo hermitage the first epithet names is itself at Kyiv, so the calendar's second epithet repeats the place rather than adding to the name. That is this reader's judgement and it is in the report.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «În anul 1840, într-o familie din Kiev se năștea al nouălea copil».

death.note: doxologia.ro: «Cuviosul Alexie a trecut la Domnul în anul 1917».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 марта ст. ст. — «Прп. Алексия Голосеевского, Киевского (1917)»

attestations.note: The calendar carries no life page for him and the day page prints no hymn under his name. The year 1917 is the one this folder already held.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 11 martie — «Sfântul Cuvios Alexie de la Goloseev»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Αλέξιος εκ Ρωσίας»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(1840 - 1917)», gives his name in the world as Vladimir Ivanovich Shepelev, puts his birth on 14 April 1840 at Kyiv of a noble family, says he was born mute and was healed at twelve by Philaret, bishop of Kyiv, whom the same site keeps on 19 Νοεμβρίου, and that he was buried in the desert of Goloseevo. It prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
